name: Ouster, Inc.
blurb: Ouster, Inc. designs and manufactures lidar sensor kits for the automotive, industrial, robotics, and smart infrastructure markets, selling across the Americas, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Its core product line — the Outer Sensor (OS) series — spans hemispheric, wide, mid-range, and long-range configurations, complemented by the DF series of solid-state digital lidar sensors aimed at advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). Founded in 2015 and headquartered in the U.S., the company employs approximately 320 people and reported trailing twelve-month revenue of $185.3 million, reflecting 57.3% year-over-year growth. Despite strong top-line expansion, Ouster remains unprofitable, with a net loss of $55.8 million and EPS of -$0.95.
recent: Ouster reported earnings on May 5, 2026, and the stock surged 26.09% on May 13, 2026 — closing at $34.17 on volume of roughly 14.7 million shares, well above typical levels — suggesting a positive post-earnings catalyst or broader sector momentum. The 52-week range of $9.77–$41.65 and a beta of 3.06 underscore the stock's high volatility. Analyst consensus sits at Strong Buy with a price target of $39.00, implying roughly 14% upside from the May 13 close.
